008package paint.generatesquares.app;
009
010import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
011import paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog;
012import paint.shared.objects.Project;
013import paint.shared.utils.*;
014
015import javax.swing.*;
016import java.nio.file.Path;
017import java.time.LocalDateTime;
018import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
019
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.GENERATE_SQUARES;
021import static paint.shared.utils.JarInfoLogger.getJarInfo;
022import static paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectPathResolver.getValidProjectPath;
023
024/**
025 * The GenerateSquares class serves as the main entry point for launching the
026 * GENERATE_SQUARES GUI application. It initializes project configuration,
027 * logging, and the runtime environment, and provides an interactive interface
028 * for selecting projects and triggering square-generation workflows.
029 * <p>
030 * Square computation and data export tasks are performed by
031 * {@link paint.generatesquares.app.GenerateSquaresHeadless}.
032 */
033public class GenerateSquares {
034
035    /**
036     * The main entry point for the GENERATE_SQUARES application. This method sets
037     * up the environment, applies system look-and-feel settings, and initializes
038     * configuration, logging, and GUI components used for selecting project
039     * directories and executing square-generation workflows.
040     *
041     * @param args command-line arguments (not used)
042     */
043    public static void main(String[] args) {
044
045        try {
046            // Use native OS look and feel (Aqua on macOS, system L&F elsewhere)
047            UIManager.setLookAndFeel(UIManager.getSystemLookAndFeelClassName());
048            System.setProperty("apple.laf.useScreenMenuBar", "true");
049            System.setProperty("swing.aatext", "true");
050            System.setProperty("swing.useSystemFontSettings", "true");
051        } catch (Exception e) {
052            e.printStackTrace();
053        }
054
055        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(new Runnable() {
056            @Override
057            public void run() {
058
059                // --- Step 1: Determine the last used valid project directory ---
060                Path projectPath = getValidProjectPath();
061                if (projectPath == null) {
062                    return;
063                }
064
065                // --- Step 2: Create console, initialize config and logger early ---
066                paint.ui.console.PaintConsoleWindow.createConsoleFor(GENERATE_SQUARES);
067                PaintLogger.initialise(projectPath, "Generate Squares.log");
068                PaintLogger.setLevel(PaintPrefs.getString("Runtime", "Log Level", "INFO"));
069                PaintConfig.initialise(projectPath);
070
071                JarInfoLogger.JarInfo info = getJarInfo(GenerateSquares.class);
072                if (info != null) {
073                    PaintLogger.infof("Version: %s", info.implementationVersion);
074                    PaintLogger.infof("Compiled: %s", info.implementationDate);
075                }
076                PaintLogger.infof("Verbose mode is %s",
077                                  PaintRuntime.isVerbose() ? "enabled" : "disabled");
078
079                String formattedTime = LocalDateTime.now()
080                                                    .format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"));
081                PaintLogger.infof("Current time is: %s", formattedTime);
082                PaintLogger.infof("Logging level is %s", PaintLogger.getLevelName());
083                PaintLogger.blankline();
084
085                // --- Step 3: Show the integrated configuration dialog ---
086                ProjectDialog dialog = new ProjectDialog(
087                        null,
088                        projectPath,
089                        ProjectDialog.DialogMode.GENERATE_SQUARES
090                );
091                paint.ui.console.PaintConsoleWindow.closeOnDialogDispose(dialog.getDialog());
092
093                // --- Step 4: Run calculations when the user presses OK ---
094                dialog.setCalculationCallback(this::runGenerateSquares);
095
096                // --- Step 5: Show dialog ---
097                dialog.showDialog();
098            }
099
100            private boolean runGenerateSquares(Project project) {
101                try {
102                    GenerateSquaresHeadless.run(
103                            project.getProjectRootPath(),
104                            project.getExperimentNames()
105                    );
106                    return true;
107
108                } catch (Exception e) {
109                    PaintLogger.errorf("Generate Squares failed: %s", e.getMessage());
110                    return false;
111                }
112            }
113        });
114    }
115
116}
